name: Emily Harrison
headline: Growth Marketing Manager
summary: Data-driven Growth Marketer with around 5 years of experience developing and executing multi-channel acquisition strategies. Skilled in SEO, analytics-driven decision making, and conversion rate optimisation through structured A/B testing. Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product and content teams to drive measurable growth.

responsibilities: Lead growth strategy across paid, organic, and lifecycle marketing channels
Design and analyse A/B tests to optimise landing page conversion rates
Manage SEO roadmap in collaboration with content and engineering teams
Monitor performance using Google Analytics and present insights to leadership
Oversee budget allocation across acquisition channels
Executed on-page and technical SEO improvements to increase organic traffic
Ran A/B tests on email campaigns to improve open and click-through rates
Built and maintained dashboards in Google Analytics for weekly reporting
Coordinated with designers to develop landing pages for paid campaigns
Assisted in keyword research and on-site SEO audits
Supported social media campaign planning and reporting
Compiled monthly performance reports using Google Analytics
